description.value: SURA is an award-winning Korean Royal Court Cuisine restaurant that has been a landmark in downtown Vancouver since 2008, earning accolades from Vancouver Magazine, Georgia Straight, and WE Vancouver. The restaurant blends timeless Korean tradition with modern elegance, offering classic dishes ranging from hearty soups and stews to Korean BBQ and lunch specials. Situated on busy Robson Street in the heart of downtown, it is a well-established destination for both locals and visitors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (5 spaces) at 69m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (1518 Robson Street, Vancouver, BC V6G 1C3) and phone (604-687-7872). OSM diet:vegetarian=yes is supported by the menu page listing salads, pancakes, rice cakes, and varied offerings consistent with vegetarian options. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or takeout is present on the website or in OSM tags; OSM reservation=no conflicts with the website's explicit reservation-by-phone instructions.
concerns: OSM tag reservation=no conflicts with website contact page, which explicitly offers phone reservations with manager callback.

The website covers multiple related restaurant brands (Sura Korean Cuisine, Sura Korean BBQ in Richmond, Hongdae Pocha Korean BBQ Vancouver); the listing should remain scoped to the 1518 Robson Street location only.
Website parking note mentions only limited free parking and street paid parking — no mention of bike parking or racks.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, award-winning full-service restaurant in a prime downtown Vancouver cycling corridor on Robson Street; a legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.
